dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Yes, I just so happen to have something that I would like to ask you.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I would like to know how you make such delicious desserts.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: *ahem* I mean, they certainly seem to suit my taste.

choices.text: The most important ingredient is patience.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I see... Though your attempts may fail, you will not give up future attempts because of a temporary setback.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: By making adjustments along the way, you compile what you've learned and accumulate experience.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I see. I'll be sure to remember that.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Now that I've benefited from your experience, I'll try to follow your instructions the next time I'm attempting optimizations on the Shogun.

choices.text: Oh, so that's what this is all about...

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Hmm? Haven't I already mentioned that I cannot make food?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: However, the advice you gave me will benefit you as well...

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: With a more powerful Shogun, I will be able to protect you from a myriad of dangers even more effectively.

choices.text: I have a feeling that it's not learning how to make desserts that you're after...
The most important ingredient is hope.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I would've never expected that trying to make desserts taste better was an expression of hope.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: But no... The more I think about it, it can't possibly be that simple.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Perhaps "hope" means the desire to satisfy the eater.
